1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

This petition has been filed for seeking quashing of the FIR No.909/2020 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Rajouri Garden, New Delhi, on the ground of settlement between the parties vide MOU/Settlement dated 26.09.2022, which is on record of this Court.
As per the learned counsel for the petitioner, all aspects of the settlement have been taken care of.

However,
the respondent No.2/complainant is not present.

2. Let Court Notice be issued to respondent No.2/complainant through the IO, to be present on the next date of hearing.
3. Petitioner No.1 be also present on the next date of hearing.
Petitioner
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:55:02 Nos.2 & 3 are exempted from appearing on the next date of hearing.

4. List on 01.09.2023.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 19, 2023/kct
This is a digitally signed order.
